topic: 工作负载证书与轮换预算
title: 读取真实PEM证书核对Istio URI身份和轮换预算，区分元数据与信任验证
review_note: 真实X.509解析与原生签发测试证书的四路/突变验收；不替代证书链或实时mTLS验证。
body:
## 操作任务
实现task.py中的assess(pem,expected_uri,now,min_remaining)。pem是最多65536字节、仅含单张PEM证书的bytes，允许首尾空白和CRLF，拒绝证书链、额外文本和损坏输入。用cryptography真实解析X.509，不信任CN。
expected_uri仅接受小写ASCII `spiffe://<trust-domain>/ns/<namespace>/sa/<service-account>`。本练习限定trust-domain匹配`[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9])?`，namespace与service-account匹配`[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?`；不解码百分号，不接受查询/fragment/额外路径。本练习语法子集不代替完整SPIFFE规范验证。
now是0..253402300799的整数UTC秒，min_remaining是非负整数，bool不算整数。输入类型/格式错误抛ValueError。
输出metadata_ready/reasons/uri_sans/not_before/not_after/remaining_seconds/sha256/trust_verified/live_mtls。按证书真实UTC秒计算有效期，now<not_before记not_yet_valid，now>=not_after记expired；未过期且剩余秒数<min_remaining记rotation_budget。URI SAN按原顺序列出，必须恰有一个且等于expected_uri，否则workload_identity，DNS SAN可并存；CN或DNS不得替代URI。原因按上述顺序排列。剩余秒数允许负值，sha256为真实DER的SHA256十六进制。无原因才metadata_ready=true；始终trust_verified=false、live_mtls="not_tested"。

## 产物
task.py，实现上述函数，不修改证书或任何信任配置。

## 验收方法
Python3与cryptography；checks/check.py真实生成并签名多份X.509证书，独立检查DER摘要、URI多值/缺失/CN冒充、信任域/SA错配、生效/到期/轮换边界、损坏/多证书PEM及非法参数。参考实现通过，骨架、典型错误和提前退出必须拒绝。

## 能力边界
仅解析本地证书元数据，不验证签名链、CA信任、吊销或私钥归属，不连接SDS/Istio/业务服务；元数据合格不等于真实mTLS成功。测试证书仅用于临时练习，不加入系统信任库。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import pathlib,sys,hashlib,datetime
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()))
from task import assess
from cryptography import x509
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes,serialization
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import ec
from cryptography.x509.oid import NameOID
UTC=datetime.timezone.utc
T=1793145600
URI='spiffe://cluster.local/ns/payments/sa/reader'
key=ec.generate_private_key(ec.SECP256R1())
def certificate(uris=(URI,),before=T-100,after=T+100,cn='unrelated.example',dns=None):
    name=x509.Name([x509.NameAttribute(NameOID.COMMON_NAME,cn)])
    b=x509.CertificateBuilder().subject_name(name).issuer_name(name).public_key(key.public_key()).serial_number(x509.random_serial_number()).not_valid_before(datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(before,UTC)).not_valid_after(datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(after,UTC))
    names=[x509.UniformResourceIdentifier(u) for u in uris]
    if dns:names.append(x509.DNSName(dns))
    if names:b=b.add_extension(x509.SubjectAlternativeName(names),critical=False)
    return b.sign(key,hashes.SHA256()).public_bytes(serialization.Encoding.PEM)
def invalid(fn):
    try:fn()
    except Exception as error:
        assert isinstance(error,ValueError),'format errors must use ValueError, got '+type(error).__name__
        return
    raise AssertionError('invalid input accepted')
pem=certificate();out=assess(pem,URI,T,100)
expected={'metadata_ready':True,'reasons':[],'uri_sans':[URI],'not_before':T-100,'not_after':T+100,'remaining_seconds':100,
          'sha256':hashlib.sha256(x509.load_pem_x509_certificate(pem).public_bytes(serialization.Encoding.DER)).hexdigest(),'trust_verified':False,'live_mtls':'not_tested'}
assert out==expected,out
assert assess(pem,URI,T+1,100)['reasons']==['rotation_budget']
assert assess(pem,URI,T-100,0)['metadata_ready']
assert assess(pem,URI,T-101,0)['reasons']==['not_yet_valid']
assert assess(pem,URI,T+100,0)['reasons']==['expired']
assert assess(pem,URI,T+101,0)['remaining_seconds']==-1
for uris in [(),('spiffe://cluster.local/ns/payments/sa/writer',),('spiffe://other.local/ns/payments/sa/reader',),(URI,URI),(URI,'spiffe://other.local/ns/payments/sa/reader')]:
    p=certificate(uris=uris,cn=URI,dns='reader.payments.svc.cluster.local')
    r=assess(p,URI,T,0);assert r['reasons']==['workload_identity'] and not r['metadata_ready'],r
assert assess(certificate(uris=(),before=T+1,after=T+100),URI,T,200)['reasons']==['not_yet_valid','rotation_budget','workload_identity']
# Whitespace and CRLF PEM do not change the DER identity or certificate digest.
assert assess(b' \n'+pem+b'\n',URI,T,100)==out
assert assess(pem.replace(b'\n',b'\r\n'),URI,T,100)==out
other=certificate();assert assess(other,URI,T,0)['sha256']!=out['sha256']
assert assess(certificate(dns='reader.payments.svc.cluster.local'),URI,T,0)['metadata_ready']
for bad in [b'',pem+pem,b'comment\n'+pem,pem+b'trailing',pem.decode(),b'-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----\nAAAA\n-----END CERTIFICATE-----',b'x'*65537]:invalid(lambda b=bad:assess(b,URI,T,0))
for uri in ['spiffe://cluster.local/ns/payments/sa/reader?admin=true','spiffe://cluster.local/ns/payments/sa/reader/','spiffe://cluster.local/ns/payments/sa/%72eader','SPIFFE://cluster.local/ns/payments/sa/reader','spiffe://cluster.local/ns/../sa/reader','spiffe://cluster.local/ns/payments/sa/reader#x',None]:invalid(lambda u=uri:assess(pem,u,T,0))
for now,budget in [(True,0),(T,True),(-1,0),(T,-1),(1.0,0),(253402300800,0)]:invalid(lambda n=now,b=budget:assess(pem,URI,n,b))
DUPLICATE_SAN = b'-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----\nMIIBgDCCASegAwIBAgIBATAKBggqhkjOPQQDAjAPMQ0wCwYDVQQDDAR0ZXN0MB4XDTI2MTAyODAw\nMDAwMFoXDTI2MTAyOTAwMDAwMFowDzENMAsGA1UEAwwEdGVzdDBZMBMGByqGSM49AgEGCCqGSM49\nAwEHA0IABAEfQKODqSytlTeC2tqJzpASd90z5Gm/w9IJRtTiK2ktxI/+ttxuU3rlm2GbdOHDnpP7\n7A9DagvdgUCUa/pd2r2jdDByMDcGA1UdEQQwMC6GLHNwaWZmZTovL2NsdXN0ZXIubG9jYWwvbnMv\ncGF5bWVudHMvc2EvcmVhZGVyMDcGA1UdEQQwMC6GLHNwaWZmZTovL2NsdXN0ZXIubG9jYWwvbnMv\ncGF5bWVudHMvc2EvcmVhZGVyMAoGCCqGSM49BAMCA0cAMEQCIFB0ibgc5WSFmW5AEaVAhRhLeZK6\nbFMFiP6HrIAKD7u7AiAtxUii3xDJVUs7flsoPwOXRfoK4GpGjEafep2ZnHGy9w==\n-----END CERTIFICATE-----\n'
try:x509.load_pem_x509_certificate(DUPLICATE_SAN).extensions
except x509.DuplicateExtension:pass
else:raise AssertionError('duplicate SAN fixture must exercise real parser failure')
invalid(lambda:assess(DUPLICATE_SAN,URI,T,0))
print('ISTIO_CERT_METADATA_BOUNDARIES_OK')
